purpose: Specification of context gathering tasks used by forge create-* skills: task list, agent instruction format, and how document search and code exploration are handled.
summary: Overview: two kinds of context gathering, document search via Skill tool and code exploration via general agent
Document search does not go through an agent
No session directory or intermediate files; agent return values held in main context
Failure rule: stop and report to the user on search failure or agent error
Task list: spec research, rule research and existing code research with executor, output and means
Agent bullet line format: path with one-line relevance reason
Per-skill matrix is owned by the orchestrator design; start-implement is out of scope
Agent instruction template of purpose, means and output contract; self-contained prompt
tasks: Defining or changing context gathering tasks
Writing prompts for existing code collection agents
title: DES-013 コンテキスト収集タスク仕様
